analysis.btc_price_note: BTC ~$81,000-$82,000 on May 12 (CoinMarketCap: $81,090, Coinbase: $81,165, OKX: $81,013). Up ~0.71% in 24h. Opened May 11 at strongest level since Jan 31. Support at $80,000, resistance at $82,000-$82,400. Fear & Greed Index 47 (Neutral), up 9pts from 38. Six consecutive weeks of net inflows into spot BTC ETFs.
analysis.regime_rationale: NEUTRAL (0.45 confidence): BTC consolidating in $80K-$82K range. April CPI release at 12:30 UTC today is the primary near-term catalyst. Hot CPI = USD strength, risk-off, bearish for BTC. Cool CPI = rate-cut hopes, bullish. Mixed technicals (15 bullish vs 17 bearish indicators, RSI 68). ETF demand (10:1 ETF absorption vs mining supply) is the structural bullish force but macro uncertainty dominates short-term.
